title: Duties of Priests and Levites

questions.question: Who bears the iniquity of the sanctuary?
options: Aaron and his sons and his father's house
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron and his sons and his father's house
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:1 (ESV): "You and your sons and your father's house with you shall bear iniquity in connection with the sanctuary..."

questions.question: What is the role of the Levites in relation to Aaron?
options: They are joined to him and minister to him
questions.correctAnswer: They are joined to him and minister to him
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:2 (ESV): "That they may be joined to you and minister to you..."

questions.question: What are the Levites NOT allowed to come near?
options: The vessels of the sanctuary and the altar
questions.correctAnswer: The vessels of the sanctuary and the altar
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:3 (ESV): "But they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary or to the altar..."

questions.question: What portion is given to the Levites as an inheritance?
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:21 (ESV): "To the Levites I have given every tithe in Israel for an inheritance..."

questions.question: What portion is given to Aaron and his sons?
options: The heave offerings, first fruits, and firstborn redemption
questions.correctAnswer: The heave offerings, first fruits, and firstborn redemption
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:8, 12-15 lists the specific offerings given to the priests.

questions.question: Does Aaron serve continuously?
options: It is a statute forever, a covenant of salt
questions.correctAnswer: It is a statute forever, a covenant of salt
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:19 (ESV): "It is a covenant of salt forever before the Lord..."

questions.question: What inheritance does Aaron have in the land?
options: None; the Lord is his portion
questions.correctAnswer: None; the Lord is his portion
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:20 (ESV): "You shall have no inheritance in their land... I am your portion and your inheritance."

questions.question: What must the Levites do with the tithe they receive?
options: Offer a tithe of it (tithe of the tithe) to the Lord/Aaron
questions.correctAnswer: Offer a tithe of it (tithe of the tithe) to the Lord/Aaron
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:26 (ESV): "You shall present... a tithe of the tithe."

questions.question: Who eats the most holy things?
Who eats the heave offerings (breasts/thighs)?
options: Aaron and his sons and daughters (everyone clean in the house)
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron and his sons and daughters (everyone clean in the house)
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:11 (ESV): "Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it."

questions.question: The redemption price for a firstborn male is?
Firstborn of which animals are NOT redeemed but sacrificed?
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:17 (ESV): "But the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat, you shall not redeem; they are holy."

questions.question: Why are the Levites given the tithe?
options: In return for their service that they do
questions.correctAnswer: In return for their service that they do
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:21 (ESV): "...in return for their service that they do, their service in the tent of meeting."

questions.question: The "covenant of salt" signifies what?
questions.explanation: Biblical idiom for an enduring, unbreakable covenant (v19).

questions.question: If Levites do not offer the best part, what happens?
questions.explanation: Numbers 18:32 (ESV): "And you shall bear no sin... when you have contributed the best of it. But... lest you die."

key_verse_text: And the Lord said to Aaron, 'You shall have no inheritance in their land... I am your portion and your inheritance among the people of Israel.'
